01# AXOVYN / distributed neural consensus
02from asyncio import gather
03from axovyn import Agent, Signal, RiskGate
04
05NETWORK = "solana"
06NODE_COUNT = 24
07QUORUM = 18
08
09specialists = {
10 "liquidity": 6,
11 "rug_risk": 6,
12 "sentiment": 6,
13 "execution": 6,
14}
15
16async def scan_pair(pair):
17 state = await pair.snapshot()
18 agents = network.assign(specialists)
19 observations = await gather(*[
20 agent.inspect(state)
21 for agent in agents
22 ])
23 return await cross_verify(observations)
24
25async def cross_verify(observations):
26 votes = network.collect(observations)
27 risk = RiskGate.evaluate(observations)
28
29 # A risk veto overrides all other votes.
30 if risk.has_veto:
31 await network.broadcast("VETO")
32 return Signal.skip(risk.reason)
33
34 agreeing = votes.count("APPROVE")
35 if agreeing < QUORUM:
36 await network.request_review()
37 return Signal.hold("NO_QUORUM")
38
39 # Consensus alone does not execute a trade.
40 signal = Signal.approved(votes.evidence)
41 return await execution.review(signal)
42
43async def review_execution(signal):
44 route = await router.quote(signal)
45 if route.slippage > limits.max_slippage:
46 return Signal.hold("PRICE_IMPACT")
47 return network.publish(signal)
48

vascular_guardian.jsINSPECT / ISOLATE / CLEAR
01// AXOVYN / vascular packet guardian
02const policy = {
03 minConfidence: 0.75,
04 maxSlippage: 0.03,
05 requireRiskClearance: true,
06};
07
08function inspectPacket(packet) {
09 const faults = [];
10
11 if (!Number.isFinite(packet.liquidity)) {
12 faults.push("INVALID_LIQUIDITY");
13 }
14 if (packet.confidence > 1) {
15 faults.push("CONFIDENCE_OUT_OF_RANGE");
16 }
17 if (packet.slippage < 0) {
18 faults.push("NEGATIVE_SLIPPAGE");
19 }
20 if (packet.riskClearance === false) {
21 faults.push("RISK_VETO");
22 }
23 return { valid: faults.length === 0, faults };
24}
25
26async function processPacket(packet) {
27 const verdict = inspectPacket(packet);
28 await monitor.trace(packet.id, "INSPECT");
29
30 if (!verdict.valid) {
31 await vascular.isolate(packet.id);
32 await monitor.trace(packet.id, "ISOLATE");
33 await quarantine.extract(packet);
34 await monitor.trace(packet.id, "EXTRACT");
35 await quarantine.remove(packet.id);
36 await monitor.trace(packet.id, "CLEARED");
37 return;
38 }
39
40 await consensus.submit(packet);
41 await vascular.resume(packet.channel);
42}
43
44// Preserve valid signals. Isolate faulty inputs.
45// Risk agents retain network-wide veto power.
